Katrina Kaif reportedly considered for Prabhas' film 'Spirit'

Reports suggest that actress Katrina Kaif may make a special appearance in actor Prabhas' upcoming film, 'Spirit'. While details remain unconfirmed, speculation indicates discussions are underway for her potential involvement. The film is directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga.
